name: v2.64.0
body:
## Breaking

The docker image has been changed from an alpine-based image to a scratch image with v1.63.

## Changelog
* 716abfc1f92608a0edfc387e65569f3b0d0025eb: ci(nightly): use the correct variables for the notification text (#6352) (Romain Baugue <rbaugue@scaleway.com>)

## What's Changed
* chore(deps): bump github.com/aws/smithy-go from 1.28.1 to 1.28.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6284
* fix(announce): add missing remplacement marks for the announcement me… by @elwinar in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6287
* feat(rdb): add config get command to generate database client snippets by @jremy42 in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/5644
* chore(deps): bump github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 from 2.3.5 to 2.3.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6283
* chore(deps): bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3 from 1.113.1 to 1.113.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6301
* chore: support more flags for the build and test tasks of the cli by @elwinar in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6302
* docs(billing): update doc to be more explicit of the specified currency by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6288
* chore(k8s): remove userdata from CLI resources and migrate commands to pool resource by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6303
* test(baremetal): select the best offer for servers based on filters by @elwinar in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6307
* fix: Correct `scripts/get.sh` for ambiguous file extension by @elwinar in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6311
* feat(mongodb): add support for create user in v1 by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6314
* fix(instance): handle stopped_in_place by @remyleone in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6313
* feat(autoscaling): add support for refresh group by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6309
* docs(containers): change documentation about private endpoint by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6315
* chore(deps-dev): bump vite from 8.2.2 to 8.3.0 in /wasm by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6317
* chore(deps): bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3 from 1.113.2 to 1.113.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6318
* chore(deps-dev): bump prettier from 3.9.6 to 3.9.9 in /wasm by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6319
* feat(search): add support for `wofl_run` and `wofl_definition` by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6320
* chore(secret): fix test helper by @estellesoulard in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6328
* chore(deps): bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2 from 1.47.0 to 1.47.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6327
* feat(instance): migrate placement-group resource to API v2 by @Mia-Cross in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6132
* chore(deps): bump github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3 from 1.113.3 to 1.113.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6326
* feat(search): add wofl product to catalog and search by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6322
* ci: generate the cover profile in the mise ci task by @elwinar in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6337
* feat(k8s): add max_termination_grace_period to internal pool API by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6332
* build(core): replace the deps management tasks with the mise native p… by @elwinar in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6340
* feat(kafka): expose CreateEndpoint and DeleteEndpoint CLI commands by @scaleway-bot in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6334
* ci(cache): improve cache handling to speed-up ci run times by @elwinar in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6343
* feat(k8s): add support for loading cloudinit using a local file by @remyleone in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6330
* ci: improve workflows notifications, logs, and caching by @elwinar in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6349
* chore(iam): remove unused  column from api-key listing by @estellesoulard in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6351
* ci(nightly): use the correct variables for the notification text by @elwinar in https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/pull/6352


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/scaleway/scaleway-cli/compare/v2.63.0...v2.64.0
